title: Hummus
intro: Silky chickpea and tahini dip with lemon, garlic and good olive oil.

steps.t: Rinse the chickpeas and warm them in a small pan of water for 5 minutes; warm ones blend creamier. Drain.
steps.label: Chickpeas

steps.t: Blend the tahini with the lemon juice and grated garlic for 1 minute, until pale and thick.
Add the chickpeas, cumin and salt and blend for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides.
With the motor running, add the ice water a spoonful at a time until smooth and fluffy.
Taste for lemon and salt, swirl onto a plate, drizzle with oil and dust with paprika.

tips.t: For restaurant-smooth hummus, rub the chickpeas between your hands in water and skim off the skins.
Top with pine nuts toasted in oil and a pinch of cinnamon for a richer plate.
Serve alongside baba ganoush with warm pita.

title: Guacamole
intro: Freshly mashed avocado with lime, onion, chili and cilantro.

steps.t: Finely chop the onion, chili and cilantro; mash half of it with the salt into a paste.
Halve the avocados, remove the pits and scoop the flesh into the bowl.
Mash with a fork, leaving some chunks, and add the lime juice.
Fold in the seeded, diced tomato and the rest of the chopped mix; adjust salt and lime.
Serve right away with tortilla chips or tacos.

tips.t: Press cling film right onto the surface to keep it green for a few hours.
Add pomegranate seeds or charred corn for a party version.
A pinch of toasted ground cumin adds warmth.

title: Tzatziki
intro: Thick Greek yogurt with cucumber, garlic and dill: cool and creamy.

steps.t: Grate the cucumber with its skin, salt it and leave in a sieve for 10 minutes, then squeeze it dry by hand.
steps.label: Cucumber

steps.t: Grate the garlic very finely and mix it with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Stir the yogurt with the cucumber, garlic, oil and chopped dill.
Chill for 30 minutes so the flavors come together; serve with a drizzle of oil.
steps.label: Chill

tips.t: Great with souvlaki, grilled vegetables or hot onion bhaji.
Use half dill, half fresh mint for an even more summery dip.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge; the garlic gets stronger over time.

title: Baba ganoush
intro: Eggplant roasted until smoky and soft, blended with tahini and lemon.

steps.t: Prick the eggplants with a fork and roast them whole at 230 °C for 45 minutes, until collapsed.
steps.label: Roast

bbq.t: Grill the whole eggplants over hot coals for 20 minutes, turning, until the skin is black and the flesh gives.

steps.t: Cover them in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel and let the flesh drain in a sieve.
steps.label: Rest

steps.t: Chop the flesh with a knife and mix with the tahini, lemon juice, grated garlic, cumin and salt.
Spread on a plate, drizzle with oil and finish with chopped parsley.

tips.t: If you have a gas hob, char the eggplants right on the flame: the smoky taste is the point.
Finish with pomegranate seeds and mint leaves.
Serve with hummus and toasted pita.
